description: Phase 4: User Preferences & Onboarding - Add a 4th optional preference selection slide to the onboarding flow. Uses existing User.interests field (String array) and existing GET /config/artwork-types endpoint. Completely optional (Skip/Complete Later). Add preferences editing to the EditProfile screen or Settings. Users without preferences get the existing feed unchanged.
steps: 1. In mobile/src/screens/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx, add a 4th slide after the existing 3 intro slides. This slide should: (a) fetch artwork types from GET /config/artwork-types (same endpoint CreateScreen uses); (b) display them as selectable chips/tags; (c) allow multi-selection; (d) have a 'Complete' button that saves selected types to the user's interests via PUT /users/me with { interests: [...selectedTypes] }; (e) have a 'Skip' or 'Complete Later' button that proceeds without saving. The slide must be fully optional - both Skip and the existing handleGetStarted should work without selections.
2. Import the api service in OnboardingScreen to make the artwork-types fetch and the profile update API call. Import from '../../services/api' or '../../services/user.service'.

3. In mobile/src/screens/profile/EditProfileScreen.tsx, add an 'Art Interests' section below the existing form fields. This should: (a) fetch artwork types from GET /config/artwork-types; (b) display them as selectable chips (similar pattern to Artwork Role selector already in the file); (c) pre-populate with the user's existing interests from profile data; (d) include interests in the handleSave payload sent to PUT /users/me.

4. Ensure the onboarding preference slide only calls the profile update API if the user is authenticated (not a guest). Guests who reach onboarding should be able to skip the preference slide gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding has 4 slides (3 existing intro + 1 new preference selection)
Preference slide fetches artwork types from /config/artwork-types API
Selected preferences are saved to User.interests via PUT /users/me
Skip/Complete Later buttons work and proceed without saving preferences
Existing onboarding functionality (Skip button at top, Get Started button) still works
EditProfileScreen includes an Art Interests section with selectable chips
EditProfileScreen pre-populates interests from current profile data
EditProfileScreen saves interests as part of the profile update
Users without any interests set experience no change in behavior
No new schema fields added to User model (uses existing interests: [String])
verification: Read OnboardingScreen.tsx and confirm 4 slides exist with preference selection on the 4th
Read EditProfileScreen.tsx and confirm interests section with chips and save logic
Verify API calls use existing endpoints only (/config/artwork-types, PUT /users/me)
findings: Implemented successfully. OnboardingScreen now has 4 slides (3 intro + 1 preference). The 4th slide fetches artwork types via api.get('/config/artwork-types'), displays them as selectable chips, and saves via userService.updateProfile on Complete. Skip button bypasses save. EditProfileScreen has Art Interests section below Artwork Role with same chip pattern (multi-select). interests field added to User interface. All API calls wrapped in try/catch for graceful failure.
